about: Product Manager with hands-on experience as a Product Manager Intern at Mepo (PT. Multi Kreasi Travel Indo), where I was recognized with the Best Award. I focus on turning user problems into clear, measurable product solutions.

At Mepo (March – October 2026), I defined product requirements, translated user needs into clear specifications, and drove feature development through cross-functional collaboration with engineering and stakeholders, always with a user-centric approach to improving the experience.
What I enjoy most about product management is the full loop: understanding who the users are, defining the problem worth solving, prioritizing what to build, and measuring whether it actually worked.
